query: Could you show me, for each post in the Facebook Pages data, its post type (status type), which category the page belongs to, and how many clicks the post received? Please include only rows where the page has a category and the post has click metrics.
sql:
SELECT
  post_history.status_type,
  page.category,
  lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_clicks
FROM post_history
INNER JOIN page ON post_history.page_id = page.id
INNER JOIN lifetime_post_metrics_total ON post_history.id = lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_id
WHERE page.category IS NOT NULL
  AND lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_clicks IS NOT NULL

query: Could you could you show me the account name, profile ID, portfolio name, and the total cost and clicks from targeting keyword reports from the Amazon Ads data? Only include groups with at least 1 records, for data from January 2022 onwards.
sql:
SELECT
  profile.account_name,
  profile.id,
  portfolio_history.name,
  campaign_history.profile_id,
  campaign_history.portfolio_id,
  SUM(targeting_keyword_report.cost) AS cost,
  SUM(targeting_keyword_report.clicks) AS clicks
FROM targeting_keyword_report
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON targeting_keyword_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
INNER JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
WHERE targeting_keyword_report.date >= '2022-01-01'
GROUP BY profile.account_name, profile.id, portfolio_history.name, campaign_history.profile_id, campaign_history.portfolio_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1

query: In the Amazon Ads ad group report data, please show me the account name, profile ID, portfolio name, campaign profile ID, campaign portfolio ID, cost, and clicks for each ad group report row? Include only report rows from November 2022 onwards.
sql:
SELECT
  profile.account_name,
  profile.id,
  portfolio_history.name,
  campaign_history.profile_id,
  campaign_history.portfolio_id,
  ad_group_level_report.cost,
  ad_group_level_report.clicks
FROM campaign_history
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON campaign_history.id = ad_group_history.campaign_id
INNER JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
INNER JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
INNER JOIN ad_group_level_report ON ad_group_history.id = ad_group_level_report.ad_group_id
WHERE ad_group_level_report.date >= '2022-11-01'
LIMIT 1000

query: I'd like to see the account name, profile ID, portfolio name, campaign profile ID, campaign portfolio ID, cost, and clicks for each campaign report row from the Amazon Ads campaign report data. Include only report rows from July 2022 onwards.
sql:
SELECT
  profile.account_name,
  profile.id,
  portfolio_history.name,
  campaign_history.profile_id,
  campaign_history.portfolio_id,
  campaign_level_report.cost,
  campaign_level_report.clicks
FROM campaign_history
INNER JOIN campaign_level_report ON campaign_history.id = campaign_level_report.campaign_id
INNER JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
INNER JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
WHERE campaign_level_report.date >= '2022-07-01'
LIMIT 1000

query: Show me the account name, profile ID, the campaign's profile ID, and for each campaign-level report the clicks, cost, and impressions from the Amazon Ads data. Please include only rows where the cost is greater than zero.
sql:
SELECT
  profile.account_name,
  profile.id,
  campaign_history.profile_id,
  campaign_level_report.clicks,
  campaign_level_report.cost,
  campaign_level_report.impressions
FROM campaign_history
INNER JOIN campaign_level_report ON campaign_history.id = campaign_level_report.campaign_id
INNER JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
WHERE campaign_level_report.cost > 0

query: For the Snapchat Ads data, please show me the ad account ID and name, the campaign's ad account ID and campaign name, the ad squad's campaign ID and ad squad name, and for each hourly report record the ad ID, impressions, spend, and date? Please include only rows where spend is greater than zero and only the latest synced row for each account, campaign, ad squad, and ad.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_account_history.id,
  ad_account_history.name,
  campaign_history.ad_account_id,
  campaign_history.name,
  ad_squad_history.campaign_id,
  ad_squad_history.name,
  ad_hourly_report.ad_id,
  ad_hourly_report.impressions,
  ad_hourly_report.spend,
  ad_hourly_report.date
FROM ad_hourly_report
INNER JOIN ad_history ON ad_hourly_report.ad_id = ad_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_squad_history ON ad_history.ad_squad_id = ad_squad_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_squad_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep ON ad_history.creative_id = snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep.creative_id
INNER JOIN ad_account_history ON snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep.ad_account_id = ad_account_history.id
WHERE ad_hourly_report.spend > 0
  AND ad_account_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM ad_account_history a2 WHERE a2.id = ad_account_history.id)
  AND campaign_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM campaign_history c2 WHERE c2.id = campaign_history.id)
  AND ad_squad_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM ad_squad_history s2 WHERE s2.id = ad_squad_history.id)
  AND ad_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM ad_history h2 WHERE h2.id = ad_history.id)

query: From the Snapchat Ads account data, could you please show me the ad ID, ad name, ad id from the report, the earliest date, total impressions, total spend, and total swipes for each ad? Group by ad and include only ads that have more than one hourly report record.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_history.id,
  ad_history.name,
  ad_hourly_report.ad_id,
  MIN(ad_hourly_report.date) AS date,
  SUM(ad_hourly_report.impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(ad_hourly_report.spend) AS spend,
  SUM(ad_hourly_report.swipes) AS swipes
FROM ad_history
INNER JOIN ad_hourly_report ON ad_history.id = ad_hourly_report.ad_id
INNER JOIN ad_squad_history ON ad_history.ad_squad_id = ad_squad_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_squad_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_account_history ON campaign_history.ad_account_id = ad_account_history.id
GROUP BY ad_history.id, ad_history.name, ad_hourly_report.ad_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

query: Could you please show me, for each ad squad, the ad squad name, total view time in milliseconds, total saves, and total shares, plus the campaign name and account name from the Snapchat Ads ad squad data? Use only the latest synced record for each ad squad, campaign, and account, aggregate the hourly report so there is one row per ad squad, include only ad squads that have some view time, and sort the results by total view time in descending order.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_squad_history.name,
  SUM(ad_squad_hourly_report.view_time_millis) AS view_time_millis,
  SUM(ad_squad_hourly_report.saves) AS saves,
  SUM(ad_squad_hourly_report.shares) AS shares,
  MAX(campaign_history.name) AS campaign_name,
  MAX(ad_account_history.name) AS account_name
FROM ad_squad_hourly_report
INNER JOIN ad_squad_history ON ad_squad_hourly_report.ad_squad_id = ad_squad_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_squad_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_account_history ON campaign_history.ad_account_id = ad_account_history.id
WHERE ad_squad_hourly_report.view_time_millis > 0
  AND ad_squad_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM ad_squad_history s2 WHERE s2.id = ad_squad_history.id)
  AND campaign_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM campaign_history c2 WHERE c2.id = campaign_history.id)
  AND ad_account_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM ad_account_history a2 WHERE a2.id = ad_account_history.id)
GROUP BY ad_squad_history.id, ad_squad_history.name
ORDER BY view_time_millis DESC

query: In the Snapchat Ads data, please retrieve the ad account name, spend, impressions, and date from the campaign hourly report? Join the campaign hourly report with campaign history on campaign ID, and then with ad account history on ad account ID. Filter to only the specific ad account ID 07da269a-5965-4b8c-8deb-c6b773b5fb9d, use only the most recently synced record for each ad account and campaign (based on the maximum Fivetran sync timestamp), restrict to records from May 29, 2022 (date >= 2022-05-29 and date < 2022-05-30), and include only rows where spend is greater than zero.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_account_history.name,
  campaign_hourly_report.spend,
  campaign_hourly_report.impressions,
  campaign_hourly_report.date
FROM campaign_hourly_report
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON campaign_hourly_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_account_history ON campaign_history.ad_account_id = ad_account_history.id
WHERE ad_account_history.id = '07da269a-5965-4b8c-8deb-c6b773b5fb9d'
  AND campaign_history.ad_account_id = '07da269a-5965-4b8c-8deb-c6b773b5fb9d'
  AND ad_account_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM ad_account_history a2 WHERE a2.id = ad_account_history.id)
  AND campaign_history._fivetran_synced = (SELECT MAX(_fivetran_synced) FROM campaign_history c2 WHERE c2.id = campaign_history.id)
  AND campaign_hourly_report.date >= '2022-05-29'
  AND campaign_hourly_report.date < '2022-05-30'
  AND campaign_hourly_report.spend > 0

query: Using the Google Ads data, could you retrieve the top 10 records of ad statistics based on the highest number of clicks? This query selects the descriptive name of the account, customer ID, number of clicks, cost in micros, number of impressions, and the date from the ad statistics table. It joins the ad statistics table with the ad history table on ad ID, then with the ad group history table on ad group ID, followed by the campaign history table on campaign ID, and finally with the account history table on customer ID. The results are ordered by the number of clicks in descending order, and no specific filter conditions are applied beyond this ordering.
sql:
SELECT
  account_history.descriptive_name,
  ad_stats.customer_id,
  ad_stats.clicks,
  ad_stats.cost_micros,
  ad_stats.impressions,
  ad_stats.date
FROM ad_stats
INNER JOIN ad_history ON ad_stats.ad_id = ad_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON ad_history.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_group_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN account_history ON campaign_history.customer_id = account_history.id
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY ad_stats.clicks DESC
LIMIT 10

query: Show me the ad group name, ad group campaign id, campaign name, campaign customer id, account descriptive name, and for each search term row the impressions and conversions from the Google Ads search term data. Include only rows where the ad group status is ENABLED, and sort the results by conversions in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_group_history.name,
  ad_group_history.campaign_id,
  campaign_history.name,
  campaign_history.customer_id,
  account_history.descriptive_name,
  search_term_keyword_stats.impressions,
  search_term_keyword_stats.conversions
FROM search_term_keyword_stats
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON search_term_keyword_stats.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON search_term_keyword_stats.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN account_history ON search_term_keyword_stats.customer_id = account_history.id
WHERE ad_group_history.status = 'ENABLED'
ORDER BY search_term_keyword_stats.conversions ASC
LIMIT 1000

query: Can you pull the account descriptive name, campaign stats date, clicks, cost in micros, impressions, and conversions from the Google Ads data? Join campaign stats with campaign history on their IDs, and then with account history using the customer ID. Include only campaigns where the last updated timestamp timestamp is less than or equal to the minimum last updated timestamp value in campaign history plus an interval of 365 days.
sql:
SELECT
  account_history.descriptive_name,
  campaign_stats.date,
  campaign_stats.clicks,
  campaign_stats.cost_micros,
  campaign_stats.impressions,
  campaign_stats.conversions
FROM campaign_stats
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON campaign_stats.id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN account_history ON campaign_history.customer_id = account_history.id
WHERE campaign_history.updated_at <= (SELECT MIN(updated_at) + INTERVAL '365 days' FROM campaign_history)

query: For the Google Ads data, please retrieve information about keyword statistics by joining the keyword statistics table with ad group history, ad group criterion history, campaign history, and account history tables? The query selects the keyword match type, number of clicks, cost in micros, number of conversions, and campaign name, while calculating the average number of impressions for each group. The results are grouped by keyword match type, clicks, cost, conversions, and campaign name. The output is ordered by the average number of impressions in descending order, and only the top 10 results are displayed.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_group_criterion_history.keyword_match_type,
  keyword_stats.clicks,
  keyword_stats.cost_micros,
  keyword_stats.conversions,
  campaign_history.name,
  AVG(keyword_stats.impressions) AS average
FROM keyword_stats
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON keyword_stats.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_group_criterion_history ON keyword_stats.ad_group_criterion_criterion_id = ad_group_criterion_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON keyword_stats.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN account_history ON keyword_stats.customer_id = account_history.id
GROUP BY
  ad_group_criterion_history.keyword_match_type,
  keyword_stats.clicks,
  keyword_stats.cost_micros,
  keyword_stats.conversions,
  campaign_history.name
ORDER BY average DESC
LIMIT 10

query: From the Instagram Business posts data, could you please show me the followers count, media count, like count, and comment count for each post? I only want posts that were created in 2020, are image posts (not video or carousel), and have comments enabled.
sql:
SELECT
  user_history.followers_count,
  user_history.media_count,
  media_insights.like_count,
  media_insights.comment_count
FROM media_history
INNER JOIN media_insights ON media_history.id = media_insights.id
INNER JOIN user_history ON media_history.user_id = user_history.id
WHERE strftime('%Y', media_history.created_time) = '2020'
  AND media_history.media_type = 'IMAGE'
  AND media_history.is_comment_enabled = 't'

query: Could you please show me the keyword name, match type, and keyword status, together with the report date, ad type, and ad status from the Microsoft Ads keyword data? I only want rows for keyword ID 83700472809459 and where the campaign status is not empty. Please sort the results by date in ascending order.
sql:

  keyword_history.name,
  keyword_history.match_type,
  keyword_history.status,
  keyword_performance_daily_report.date,
  ad_history.type,
  ad_history.status

INNER JOIN ad_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.ad_id = ad_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id

query: In the Microsoft Ads ad report data, please show me the date, clicks, impressions, ad type, ad status, campaign name, and campaign budget? Restrict to ad ID 83631648270349, to dates between May 1 and May 7 in 2019, and to rows where that ad has at least one later date in the report and impressions are greater than zero. Show the earlier-day row for each such pair.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_performance_daily_report.date,
  ad_performance_daily_report.clicks,
  ad_performance_daily_report.impressions,
  ad_history.type,
  ad_history.status,
  campaign_history.name,
  campaign_history.budget
FROM ad_performance_daily_report
INNER JOIN ad_performance_daily_report AS ad_performance_daily_report_later
  ON ad_performance_daily_report.ad_id = ad_performance_daily_report_later.ad_id
  AND ad_performance_daily_report.date < ad_performance_daily_report_later.date
INNER JOIN ad_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.ad_id = ad_history.id
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN account_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.account_id = account_history.id
WHERE ad_performance_daily_report.ad_id = ad_performance_daily_report_later.ad_id
  AND ad_performance_daily_report.date < ad_performance_daily_report_later.date
  AND ad_performance_daily_report.impressions > 0
  AND ad_performance_daily_report.ad_id = 83631648270349
  AND ad_performance_daily_report.date BETWEEN '2019-05-01' AND '2019-05-07'

query: Using the microsoft_ads data, the query retrieves the columns ad_group_history.id, ad_group_history.name, ad_group_history.status, ad_group_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id, and campaign_history.id. It joins the ad_group_performance_daily_report table with the ad_group_history table on the ad_group_id column, the campaign_history table on the campaign_id column, and the account_history table on the account_id column. The query filters the results to include only rows where the ad_group_id in ad_group_performance_daily_report matches the id in ad_group_history, the campaign_id in ad_group_history matches the id in campaign_history, and the status in ad_group_history is 'Active'.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_group_history.id,
  ad_group_history.name,
  ad_group_history.status,
  ad_group_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id,
  campaign_history.id
FROM ad_group_performance_daily_report
INNER JOIN ad_group_history ON ad_group_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_group_performance_daily_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN account_history ON ad_group_performance_daily_report.account_id = account_history.id

  AND ad_group_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
  AND ad_group_history.status = 'Active'

query: Show me the campaign name, campaign budget, campaign status, account name, and the report date from the Microsoft Ads campaign report data. Restrict to campaign ID 359751135, to dates between May 1 and May 7 in 2019, and to rows where impressions are greater than zero.

  campaign_history.budget,
  campaign_history.status,
  account_history.name,

query: Using the Apple Search Ads keyword data, could you please show me the ad group id, ad group name, ad group status, ad group serving status, the keyword's ad group id, local spend amount, and conversions for each row? I only want rows where local spend amount is greater than zero.

SELECT
  ad_group_history.id,
  ad_group_history.name,
  ad_group_history.status,
  ad_group_history.serving_status,
  keyword_history.ad_group_id,
  keyword_report.local_spend_amount,
  keyword_report.conversions
FROM ad_group_history
INNER JOIN keyword_history ON ad_group_history.id = keyword_history.ad_group_id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_group_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
INNER JOIN organization ON ad_group_history.organization_id = organization.id
INNER JOIN keyword_report ON keyword_history.id = keyword_report.id

query: For the Apple Search Ads ad group report data, please show me the ad group name, ad group serving status, campaign name, organization name, report date, local spend amount, and conversions for each daily record? I only want rows where local spend amount is greater than zero.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_group_history.name,
  ad_group_history.serving_status,
  campaign_history.name,
  organization.name,
  ad_group_report.date,
  ad_group_report.local_spend_amount,
  ad_group_report.conversions
FROM ad_group_history
INNER JOIN ad_group_report ON ad_group_history.id = ad_group_report.ad_group_id
INNER JOIN organization ON ad_group_history.organization_id = organization.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_group_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
WHERE CAST(ad_group_report.local_spend_amount AS REAL) > 0

query: From the Apple Search Ads data, could you identify the top 10 combinations of campaign payment models and organization payment models based on total spending? This analysis involves joining the campaign history table with the campaign report table on their IDs and further joining with the organization table using the organization ID. The query filters out any campaigns marked as deleted (where deleted is 'f') and groups the results by both the campaign's and organization's payment models. It calculates the total spend and total conversions for each group, ordering the results by total spend in descending order, and limits the output to the top 10 entries.
sql:
SELECT
  campaign_history.payment_model,
  organization.payment_model,
  SUM(CAST(campaign_report.local_spend_amount AS REAL)) AS total_spend,
  SUM(CAST(campaign_report.conversions AS INTEGER)) AS total_conversions
FROM campaign_history
INNER JOIN campaign_report ON campaign_history.id = campaign_report.id
INNER JOIN organization ON campaign_history.organization_id = organization.id
WHERE campaign_history.deleted = 'f'
GROUP BY campaign_history.payment_model, organization.payment_model
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10

query: Could you please show me the ad group id, ad group name, ad group serving status, the report's ad group id, taps, local spend amount, conversions, and campaign name for each ad-level daily record from the Apple Search Ads ad report data?   ad_level_report.taps,
  ad_level_report.local_spend_amount,

query: From the TikTok Ads data, could you please show me the ad name, ad group name, campaign name, advertiser name, and for each hourly record the spend, impressions, clicks, likes, and follows? Only include ads that have at least one hourly report row with spend greater than zero.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_history.ad_name,
  adgroup_history.adgroup_name,
  campaign_history.campaign_name,
  advertiser.name,
  ad_report_hourly.spend,
  ad_report_hourly.impressions,
  ad_report_hourly.clicks,
  ad_report_hourly.likes,
  ad_report_hourly.follows
FROM ad_history
INNER JOIN advertiser ON ad_history.advertiser_id = advertiser.id
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON ad_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.campaign_id
INNER JOIN ad_report_hourly ON ad_history.ad_id = ad_report_hourly.ad_id
INNER JOIN adgroup_history ON ad_history.adgroup_id = adgroup_history.adgroup_id
WHERE ad_history.ad_id IN (SELECT ad_id FROM ad_report_hourly WHERE CAST(spend AS REAL) > 0)

query: Could you please show me the campaign name and, for each hourly ad group report, the spend, likes, and follows from the TikTok Ads data? I only want rows where that hour has at least some spend, likes, or follows-please exclude any hourly records where all three are zero.
sql:
SELECT
  adgroup_report_hourly.spend,
  adgroup_report_hourly.likes,
  adgroup_report_hourly.follows,
  campaign_history.campaign_name
FROM adgroup_history
INNER JOIN campaign_history ON adgroup_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.campaign_id
INNER JOIN adgroup_report_hourly ON adgroup_history.adgroup_id = adgroup_report_hourly.adgroup_id
WHERE (adgroup_report_hourly.adgroup_id, adgroup_report_hourly.stat_time_hour) NOT IN (SELECT adgroup_id, stat_time_hour FROM adgroup_report_hourly WHERE CAST(spend AS REAL) = 0 AND CAST(likes AS INTEGER) = 0 AND CAST(follows AS INTEGER) = 0)

query: In the TikTok Ads data, please show me the ad operation status, when the ad was created, the hourly impressions and clicks, the advertiser name, and the rejected reason? I only want rows where the advertiser has no rejection on file-so where rejected reason is null or blank.
sql:
SELECT
  ad_history.operation_status,
  ad_history.create_time,
  ad_report_hourly.impressions,
  ad_report_hourly.clicks,
  advertiser.rejected_reason,
  advertiser.name
FROM ad_history
INNER JOIN advertiser ON ad_history.advertiser_id = advertiser.id
INNER JOIN ad_report_hourly ON ad_history.ad_id = ad_report_hourly.ad_id
WHERE (advertiser.rejected_reason IS NULL OR advertiser.rejected_reason = '')

query: I'd like to see the campaign name, campaign budget, budget mode, and hourly spend from the TikTok Ads data. I want to see both types of rows in one result: first all hourly records where spend is greater than zero, and then all hourly records where spend is zero, combined together.
sql:
SELECT
  campaign_history.campaign_name,
  campaign_history.budget,
  campaign_history.budget_mode,
  ad_report_hourly.spend
