sql: SELECT t3.account_name, t3.account_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS unique_campaigns, SUM(t1.budget) AS total_budget FROM "amazon_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_ads"."profile" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.profile_id GROUP BY t3.account_name, t3.account_type ORDER BY total_budget DESC

query: Retrieve the campaign names, ad group names, total cost, total clicks, total impressions, and report dates for campaigns that are currently enabled from the Amazon Ads database, with data grouped by campaign name, ad group name, and report date.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS campaign_name, t2.name AS ad_group_name, CAST(SUM(t5.cost) AS FLOAT) AS total_cost, SUM(t5.clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(t5.impressions) AS total_impressions, t5.date AS report_date FROM "amazon_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t2 ON t2.campaign_id = t1.id JOIN "amazon_ads"."ad_group_level_report" AS t5 ON t5.ad_group_id = t2.id WHERE t1.state = 'enabled' GROUP BY t1.name, t2.name, t5.date

query: Retrieve the name and state of each campaign, along with the account name, currency code, and the count of records in the Amazon Ads database. The data is grouped by campaign name, state, account name, and currency code.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS campaign_name, t2.state, t3.account_name, t3.currency_code, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "amazon_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_ads"."campaign_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "amazon_ads"."profile" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.profile_id GROUP BY t2.name, t2.state, t3.account_name, t3.currency_code

query: Retrieve the most recent five days of data for impressions and taps along with the campaign names from the Apple Search Ads database.
sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t1.impressions, t1.taps, t3.name AS campaign_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.id ORDER BY t1.date DESC) AS row_num
    FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_level_report" AS t1
    JOIN "apple_search_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id
)
SELECT date, impressions, taps, campaign_name FROM cte WHERE row_num <= 5

query: Retrieve the names of ad groups and campaigns along with their budget amounts from the Apple Search Ads database, and provide the count of records for each combination of ad group name, campaign name, and budget amount.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_group_name, t2.name AS campaign_name, t2.budget_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "apple_search_ads"."campaign_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.campaign_id GROUP BY t1.name, t2.name, t2.budget_amount

query: Retrieve the organization name, currency, date, total spend, total conversions, and average conversion rate from the Apple Search Ads database, grouped by organization name, currency, and date.
sql: SELECT t3.name, t3.currency, t2.date, SUM(t2.local_spend_amount) AS total_spend, SUM(t2.conversions) AS total_conversions, AVG(t2.conversion_rate) AS avg_conversion_rate FROM "apple_search_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "apple_search_ads"."campaign_report" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.id JOIN "apple_search_ads"."organization" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.organization_id GROUP BY t3.name, t3.currency, t2.date

query: Retrieve the report showing each date's total impressions and average spend amount, organized by campaign name, ad group name, and organization name from the Apple Search Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t1.date AS report_date, t3.name AS campaign_name, t4.name AS ad_group_name, t5.name AS organization_name, SUM(t1.impressions) AS total_impressions, AVG(t1.local_spend_amount) AS avg_spend
FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_level_report" AS t1
JOIN "apple_search_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_id
JOIN "apple_search_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id
JOIN "apple_search_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
JOIN "apple_search_ads"."organization" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.org_id
GROUP BY t1.date, t3.name, t4.name, t5.name

query: Retrieve the total number of creative IDs and campaign IDs, along with the name and status of each ad, as well as the organization name and currency, from the Apple Search Ads database, grouping the results by ad name, ad status, organization name, and organization currency.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t2.creative_id), 0) AS total_creative_id, t2.name AS ad_name, t2.status AS ad_status, COALESCE(SUM(t2.campaign_id), 0) AS total_campaign_id, t5.name AS organization_name, t5.currency AS organization_currency FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 JOIN "apple_search_ads"."organization" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.org_id GROUP BY t2.name, t2.status, t5.name, t5.currency

query: Retrieve the top 10 dates with the highest number of impressions for each ad group along with the ad group name and organization name from the Apple Search Ads database.
sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t1.impressions, t4.name AS ad_group_name, t5.name AS org_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.id ORDER BY t1.impressions DESC) AS rn
    FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_level_report" AS t1
    JOIN "apple_search_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_id
    JOIN "apple_search_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
    JOIN "apple_search_ads"."organization" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.org_id
)
SELECT date, impressions, ad_group_name, org_name FROM cte WHERE rn <= 10

query: Retrieve the ad group names, keyword texts, and campaign names along with the average bid amounts from the Apple Search Ads database, grouped by ad group name, keyword text, and campaign name.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_group_name, t2.text AS keyword_text, t3.name AS campaign_name, AVG(t2.bid_amount) AS avg_bid_amount FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "apple_search_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "apple_search_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id  GROUP BY t1.name, t2.text, t3.name

query: Retrieve the names and currencies of organizations along with the average budget amount for each campaign from the Apple Search Ads database, grouped by organization name, currency, and campaign name.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS organization_name, t3.currency AS organization_currency, AVG(t4.budget_amount) AS average_campaign_budget, t4.name AS campaign_name FROM "apple_search_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "apple_search_ads"."campaign_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "apple_search_ads"."organization" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.organization_id GROUP BY t3.name, t3.currency, t4.name

query: Show the most recent three final URLs along with their associated campaign names and account names from the Google Ads database.
sql:
WITH cte1 AS (
    SELECT t2.final_urls, t3.name AS campaign_name, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.id ORDER BY t2.id DESC) AS row_num
    FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1
    JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id
    JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id
    JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.customer_id
),
cte2 AS (
    SELECT final_urls, campaign_name, account_name FROM cte1 WHERE row_num <= 3
)
SELECT * FROM cte2

query: Retrieve the average optimization score for each combination of ad group name, campaign name, keyword text, keyword match type, and account name from the Google Ads database.
sql: WITH keyword_report AS (SELECT t2.name AS ad_group_name, t2.campaign_name, t3.keyword_text, t3.keyword_match_type, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name, COUNT(*) AS avg_optimization_score FROM "google_ads"."keyword_stats" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_group_id JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.customer_id JOIN "google_ads"."ad_group_criterion_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_group_criterion_criterion_id GROUP BY t2.name, t2.campaign_name, t3.keyword_text, t3.keyword_match_type, t5.descriptive_name) SELECT * FROM keyword_report

query: Retrieve the name, type, and status of each ad along with the average optimization score, account name, and currency from the Google Ads database, grouped by ad name, type, status, account name, and currency.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS ad_name, t2.type AS ad_type, t2.status AS ad_status, COUNT(*) AS avg_optimization_score, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name, t5.currency_code AS currency FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.customer_id GROUP BY t2.name, t2.type, t2.status, t5.descriptive_name, t5.currency_code

query: Retrieve the total clicks and total impressions for each ad name and type, along with the date, ad network type, device, and currency code from the Google Ads database. The data is grouped by ad name, ad type, date, ad network type, device, and currency code.
sql: SELECT t2.name, t2.type, t4.date, t4.ad_network_type, t4.device, SUM(t4.clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, t5.currency_code FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."ad_stats" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.customer_id  GROUP BY t2.name, t2.type, t4.date, t4.ad_network_type, t4.device, t5.currency_code

query: Retrieve the most recent ad group name, its status, and the associated campaign name from the Google Ads database for each campaign.
sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT t1.name AS ad_group_name, t1.status, t2.name AS campaign_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.id ORDER BY t1.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1
    JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.campaign_id
)
SELECT ad_group_name, status, campaign_name FROM cte WHERE rn = 1

query: Retrieve the campaign name, advertising channel type, campaign status, and ad network type along with the total clicks, total cost in micros, and average impressions for each campaign from the Google Ads database.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS campaign_name, t3.advertising_channel_type AS channel_type, t3.status AS campaign_status, t4.ad_network_type AS network_type, SUM(t4.clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(t4.cost_micros) AS total_cost_micros, AVG(t4.impressions) AS avg_impressions FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."ad_stats" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id GROUP BY t3.name, t3.advertising_channel_type, t3.status, t4.ad_network_type

query: Retrieve the name, type, status, display URL, currency code, and optimization score of ads from the Google Ads database, along with the count of these optimization scores, grouped by ad name, type, status, display URL, currency code, and optimization score.
sql: SELECT t2.name, t2.type, t2.status, t2.display_url, t5.currency_code, t5.optimization_score, COUNT(*) AS avg_optimization_score FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.customer_id GROUP BY t2.name, t2.type, t2.status, t2.display_url, t5.currency_code, t5.optimization_score

query: Retrieve the top five ad groups with the highest number of clicks, along with their impressions and associated account names, from the Google Ads database.
sql:
WITH cte1 AS (
    SELECT t1.name AS ad_group_name, t3.clicks, t3.impressions, t4.descriptive_name AS account_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.id ORDER BY t3.clicks DESC) AS row_num
    FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1
    JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.campaign_id
    JOIN "google_ads"."ad_group_stats" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.id
    JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t2.customer_id
),
cte2 AS (
    SELECT ad_group_name, clicks, impressions, account_name FROM cte1 WHERE row_num <= 5
)
SELECT * FROM cte2

query: Retrieve the total number of clicks and total cost for each ad group name, campaign name, advertising channel type, and device type from the Google Ads database.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_group_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, t3.advertising_channel_type AS channel_type, t4.device AS device_type, SUM(t4.clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(t4.cost_micros) AS total_cost FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."ad_stats" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id GROUP BY t1.name, t3.name, t3.advertising_channel_type, t4.device

query: Retrieve the ad group names, campaign names, total clicks, average cost in micros, currency code, and account name from the Google Ads database, grouped by ad group name, campaign name, currency code, and account name.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_group_name, t1.campaign_name, SUM(t4.clicks) AS total_clicks, AVG(t4.cost_micros) AS average_cost, t5.currency_code, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."ad_stats" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.customer_id GROUP BY t1.name, t1.campaign_name, t5.currency_code, t5.descriptive_name

query: Retrieve the top five ad groups, along with their associated keywords, campaign names, and account names from the Google Ads database, ordered by campaign ID in descending order.
sql:
WITH cte1 AS (
    SELECT t2.name AS ad_group_name, t3.keyword_text, t4.name AS campaign_name, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.id ORDER BY t2.id DESC) AS row_num
    FROM "google_ads"."keyword_stats" AS t1
    JOIN "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_group_id
    JOIN "google_ads"."ad_group_criterion_history" AS t3 ON t3.ad_group_id = t1.ad_group_id
    JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t2.campaign_id
    JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t4.customer_id
),
cte2 AS (
    SELECT ad_group_name, keyword_text, campaign_name, account_name FROM cte1 WHERE row_num <= 5
)
SELECT * FROM cte2

query: Retrieve the campaign names, advertising channel types, total number of clicks, and average cost in micros from the Google Ads database, grouped by campaign name and channel type.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS campaign_name, t3.advertising_channel_type AS channel_type, CAST(SUM(t4.clicks) AS INTEGER) AS total_clicks, CAST(AVG(t4.cost_micros) AS FLOAT) AS average_cost_micros FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_group_id = t1.id JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."ad_stats" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id  GROUP BY t3.name, t3.advertising_channel_type

query: Retrieve the campaign ID, ad group name, campaign name, advertising channel type, and account name, along with the total count of optimization scores, from the Google Ads database. The data is grouped by campaign ID, ad group name, campaign name, advertising channel type, and account name.
sql: SELECT t1.campaign_id, t1.name AS ad_group_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, t3.advertising_channel_type, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name, COUNT(*) AS total_optimization_score FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "google_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.customer_id GROUP BY t1.campaign_id, t1.name, t3.name, t3.advertising_channel_type, t5.descriptive_name

query: Retrieve the keyword statistics and historical data for up to 1000 keyword criteria in the Google Ads database, including total clicks and conversions by customer, along with account details such as account name, currency code, manager, and optimization score.
sql:
WITH KeywordStats AS (
  SELECT customer_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id, ad_group_criterion_criterion_id,
    SUM(CAST(clicks AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS total_clicks,
    SUM(CAST(conversions AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS total_conversions
  FROM google_ads.keyword_stats
),
AdGroupCriterionHistory AS (
  SELECT t3.id, t3.ad_group_id, t3.keyword_text, t3.keyword_match_type,
    ks.total_clicks, ks.total_conversions, ks.customer_id
  FROM google_ads.ad_group_criterion_history t3
  JOIN KeywordStats ks ON t3.ad_group_id = ks.ad_group_id
)
SELECT agch.id AS criterion_id, agch.keyword_text, agch.keyword_match_type,
  agch.total_clicks, agch.total_conversions,
  ad.id AS account_id, ad.descriptive_name, ad.currency_code, ad.manager, ad.optimization_score
FROM AdGroupCriterionHistory agch
JOIN google_ads.account_history ad ON agch.customer_id = ad.id
LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the ad group criterion details including ID, ad group ID, base campaign ID, update time, type, status, keyword match type, and keyword text, along with the account information such as ID, update time, auto tagging status, currency code, name, final URL suffix, visibility, manager status, manager customer ID, optimization score, pay-per-conversion eligibility reasons, test account status, time zone, and tracking URL template from the Google Ads database, limited to the first 1000 results.
sql: SELECT t3.id AS ad_group_criterion_id, t3.ad_group_id AS ad_group_id, t3.base_campaign_id AS base_campaign_id, t3.updated_at AS criterion_updated_at, t3.type AS criterion_type, t3.status AS criterion_status, t3.keyword_match_type AS keyword_match_type, t3.keyword_text AS keyword_text, t5.id AS account_id, t5.updated_at AS account_updated_at, t5.auto_tagging_enabled AS auto_tagging_enabled, t5.currency_code AS currency_code, t5.descriptive_name AS account_name, t5.final_url_suffix AS final_url_suffix, t5.hidden AS account_hidden, t5.manager AS is_manager, t5.manager_customer_id AS manager_customer_id, t5.optimization_score AS optimization_score, t5.pay_per_conversion_eligibility_failure_reasons AS pay_per_conversion_eligibility_failure_reasons, t5.test_account AS is_test_account, t5.time_zone AS account_time_zone, t5.tracking_url_template AS account_tracking_url_template FROM google_ads.ad_group_criterion_history t3 INNER JOIN google_ads.keyword_stats t1 ON t3.ad_group_id = t1.ad_group_id INNER JOIN google_ads.account_history t5 ON t1.customer_id = t5.id LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the most recently updated information for up to six ad groups per campaign, including their ID, name, status, and update date, along with the campaign name and advertising channel type, from the Google Ads database. Additionally, show the count of ad groups for each advertising channel type.
sql: WITH recent_records AS (SELECT t1.id AS ad_group_id, t1.updated_at AS ad_group_updated_at, t1.name AS ad_group_name, t1.status AS ad_group_status, t3.name AS campaign_name, t3.advertising_channel_type AS channel_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.campaign_id ORDER BY t1.updated_at DESC) AS row_num FROM "google_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t1 JOIN "google_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id) SELECT ad_group_id, ad_group_updated_at, ad_group_name, ad_group_status, campaign_name, channel_type, COUNT(ad_group_id) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_type) AS ad_group_count FROM recent_records WHERE row_num <= 6

query: Retrieve the media ID, caption, media type, like count, and comment count for each media post from the Instagram Business database, combining insights and media history details.
sql:
WITH cte1 AS (
    SELECT t1.id AS media_id, t1.caption, t1.media_type
    FROM "instagram_business"."media_history" AS t1
),
cte2 AS (
    SELECT t2.id AS insight_id, t2.like_count, t2.comment_count
    FROM "instagram_business"."media_insights" AS t2
)
SELECT cte1.media_id, cte1.caption, cte1.media_type, cte2.like_count, cte2.comment_count
FROM cte1
JOIN cte2 ON cte2.insight_id = cte1.media_id

query: Retrieve the ad titles, final URLs, modification times, account names, and currency codes from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.modified_time, t5.name, t5.currency_code
FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.account_id
GROUP BY t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.modified_time, t5.name, t5.currency_code

query: Retrieve the titles, final URLs, names, languages, and total budgets of campaigns from the Microsoft Ads database, and show whether each ad is currently running or stopped, with the results grouped by ad title, final URL, campaign name, language, and ad status.
sql: SELECT t3.title, t3.final_url, t5.name, t5.language, SUM(t5.budget) AS total_budget, CASE WHEN t3.status = 'Active' THEN 'Running' ELSE 'Stopped' END AS ad_status FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id GROUP BY t3.title, t3.final_url, t5.name, t5.language, t3.status

query: Retrieve the names of keywords, their match types, corresponding ad titles, ad group names, campaign names, and campaign budgets from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t2.name AS keyword_name, t2.match_type, t3.title_part_1 AS ad_title, t4.name AS ad_group_name, t5.name AS campaign_name, t5.budget AS campaign_budget
FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id

query: Retrieve the campaign name, status, and budget, along with the ad title and status, keyword name and match type, and the total budget for each campaign from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql: SELECT t5.name AS campaign_name, t5.status AS campaign_status, t5.budget AS campaign_budget, t3.title_part_1 AS ad_title, t3.status AS ad_status, t2.name AS keyword_name, t2.match_type AS keyword_match_type, SUM(t5.budget) AS total_budget FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id GROUP BY t5.name, t5.status, t5.budget, t3.title_part_1, t3.status, t2.name, t2.match_type

query: Retrieve the top five keywords along with their associated ad titles and ad group names from the Microsoft Ads database, prioritizing the most recent entries for each ad group.
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT t2.name AS keyword_name, t3.title_part_1 AS ad_title, t4.name AS ad_group_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.id ORDER BY t2.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
)
SELECT keyword_name, ad_title, ad_group_name FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5

query: Retrieve the ad group names, statuses, and last modified times, along with the account names, currencies, and last modification times from the Microsoft Ads database, limited to the first 1000 results.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS ad_group_name, t2.status AS ad_group_status, t2.modified_time AS ad_group_last_modified, t5.name AS account_name, t5.currency_code AS account_currency, t5.last_modified_time AS account_last_modified FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_group_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.account_id LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the keyword names, their match types and statuses, the associated ad group names and statuses, along with the account names and currency codes from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t2.name AS keyword_name, t2.match_type, t2.status AS keyword_status, t4.name AS ad_group_name, t4.status AS ad_group_status, t6.name AS account_name, t6.currency_code
FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id

query: Retrieve the top five ad titles, along with their corresponding ad group and campaign names, sorted by ad group within each campaign from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT t3.title_part_1 AS ad_title, t4.name AS ad_group_name, t5.name AS campaign_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.id ORDER BY t4.id) AS row_num
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id
)
SELECT ad_title, ad_group_name, campaign_name FROM cte WHERE row_num <= 5

query: Retrieve the ad title, destination URL, last modified timestamp, ad status, account name, and account currency from the Microsoft Ads database, limited to the first 1000 results.
sql: SELECT t3.title_part_1 AS ad_title, t3.final_url AS destination_url, t3.modified_time::timestamp AS last_modified, t3.status AS ad_status, t5.name AS account_name, t5.currency_code AS account_currency FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.account_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the campaign name, language, budget, ad group name, ad title, and ad status from the Microsoft Ads database, along with the total budget for each campaign, grouped by campaign and ad details.
sql: SELECT t5.name AS campaign_name, t5.language AS campaign_language, t5.budget AS total_budget, t4.name AS ad_group_name, t3.title AS ad_title, t3.status AS ad_status, SUM(t5.budget) AS total_campaign_budget FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id GROUP BY t5.name, t5.language, t5.budget, t4.name, t3.title, t3.status

query: Retrieve ad titles, final URLs, statuses, types, account names, and currency codes from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t3.title, t3.final_url, t3.status, t3.type, t6.name, t6.currency_code
FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.ad_group_id = t1.ad_group_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id
GROUP BY t3.title, t3.final_url, t3.status, t3.type, t6.name, t6.currency_code

query: Retrieve the ad title, final URL, ad group name, status, and the last modified timestamp for each ad from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql: SELECT t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t4.name, t4.status, CAST(t4.modified_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS t4_modified_timestamp FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id

query: Retrieve the title of the ad, the campaign name, language, status, and account time zone from the Microsoft Ads database, along with the total budget, grouped by each unique combination of ad title, campaign name, language, status, and time zone.
sql: SELECT t3.title, t5.name, t5.language, t5.status, t6.time_zone, SUM(t5.budget) AS total_budget FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id GROUP BY t3.title, t5.name, t5.language, t5.status, t6.time_zone

query: Retrieve the average number of clicks along with the ad title, final URL, account name, and currency code from the Microsoft Ads database, grouped by ad title, final URL, account name, and currency code.
sql:
SELECT t3.title, t3.final_url, t6.name, t6.currency_code, AVG(t1.clicks) AS avg_clicks
FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id
GROUP BY t3.title, t3.final_url, t6.name, t6.currency_code

query: Retrieve the title, final URL, and modification date of ads along with the account name, account last modified time, and currency code from the Microsoft Ads database, limited to the top 1000 records.
sql: SELECT t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.modified_time, t5.name, t5.last_modified_time, t5.currency_code FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.account_id LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve campaign names, account names, currency codes, languages, and total budgets from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t3.name AS campaign_name, t4.name AS account_name, t4.currency_code, t3.language, SUM(CAST(t3.budget AS DOUBLE)) AS total_budget
FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.account_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id
GROUP BY t3.name, t4.name, t4.currency_code, t3.language

query: Retrieve the account names, report dates, ad group names, total clicks, ad titles, and final URLs for each ad from the Microsoft Ads database, and group the data by account name, report date, ad group name, ad title, and final URL.
sql: SELECT t5.name AS account_name, CAST(t1.date AS DATE) AS report_date, t2.name AS ad_group_name, SUM(t1.clicks) AS total_clicks, t3.title AS ad_title, t3.final_url AS ad_final_url FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_group_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.account_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id GROUP BY t5.name, CAST(t1.date AS DATE), t2.name, t3.title, t3.final_url

query: Retrieve the ad titles, final URLs, modification times, statuses, account names, and currency codes from the Microsoft Ads database, grouped by each of these attributes.
sql:
SELECT t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.modified_time::VARCHAR AS modified_time, t3.status, t6.name, t6.currency_code
FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
GROUP BY t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.modified_time, t3.status, t6.name, t6.currency_code

query: Retrieve the date, account name, campaign name, total clicks, total impressions, device type, and network type categorized as either 'First Party' or 'Third Party' from the Microsoft Ads database, grouped by date, account name, campaign name, device type, and network type.
sql: SELECT t1.date, t4.name AS account_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, SUM(t1.clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(t1.impressions) AS total_impressions, t1.device_type, CASE WHEN t1.network = 'Owned & Operated' THEN 'First Party' ELSE 'Third Party' END AS network_type FROM "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.account_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id GROUP BY t1.date, t4.name, t3.name, t1.device_type, t1.network

query: Retrieve the top-ranking search queries by total clicks for each date, along with their associated keyword names and account names, from the Microsoft Ads database.
sql: WITH ranked_search_queries AS (SELECT t1.date, t1.search_query, t2.name AS keyword_name, t6.name AS account_name, SUM(t1.clicks) AS total_clicks, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.search_query ORDER BY SUM(t1.clicks) DESC) AS rank FROM "microsoft_ads"."search_query_performance_daily_report" AS t1 JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id GROUP BY t1.date, t1.search_query, t2.name, t6.name) SELECT ranked_search_queries.date, ranked_search_queries.search_query, ranked_search_queries.keyword_name, ranked_search_queries.account_name, ranked_search_queries.total_clicks, ranked_search_queries.rank FROM ranked_search_queries WHERE ranked_search_queries.rank = 1

query: Retrieve the total occurrences and unique dates for each keyword and its match type from the Microsoft Ads database, grouped by keyword name and match type.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t1.device_os, t2.name AS keyword_name, t2.match_type
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id
)
SELECT keyword_name, match_type, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS unique_dates
FROM base_data
GROUP BY keyword_name, match_type

query: Retrieve the average impressions along with the ad title, final URL, ad status, account name, currency code, and time zone from the Microsoft Ads database, grouping the results by ad title, final URL, ad status, account name, currency code, and time zone.
sql:
SELECT t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.status, t6.name, t6.currency_code, t6.time_zone, AVG(t1.impressions) AS avg_impressions
FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id
JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
GROUP BY t3.title_part_1, t3.final_url, t3.status, t6.name, t6.currency_code, t6.time_zone

query: Retrieve the count of records and the number of unique keywords for each match category, classified as High Precision, Medium Precision, or Broad Match, from the Microsoft Ads database, based on the keyword match type.
sql:
WITH categorized_data AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t2.name AS keyword_name, t4.name AS ad_group_name,
           CASE 
               WHEN t2.match_type = 'Exact' THEN 'High Precision'
               WHEN t2.match_type = 'Phrase' THEN 'Medium Precision'
               ELSE 'Broad Match'
           END AS match_category
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
)
SELECT match_category, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT keyword_name) AS unique_keywords
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY match_category

query: Retrieve the total number of records and the count of unique ads for each ad group from the Microsoft Ads database, grouped by ad group name.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t1.device_os, t3.title_part_1 AS ad_title, t4.name AS ad_group_name
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."ad_group_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t1.ad_group_id
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT ad_group_name, COUNT(*) AS total_records, COUNT(DISTINCT ad_title) AS unique_ads
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY ad_group_name
)
SELECT * FROM aggregated

query: Retrieve the number of records and the count of unique keywords for each campaign from the Microsoft Ads database, but only include campaigns with more than five records.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t2.name AS keyword_name, t5.name AS campaign_name
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."keyword_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.keyword_id
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."campaign_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t1.campaign_id
)
SELECT campaign_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT keyword_name) AS unique_keywords
FROM base_data
GROUP BY campaign_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

query: Retrieve the most recent ten records of daily keyword performance reports, including the date, device operating system, currency, and account name, from the Microsoft Ads database, ranked by date for each account.
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT t1.date, t1.device_os, t1.currency_code, t6.name AS account_name,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t6.id ORDER BY t1.date DESC) AS date_rank,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t6.id ORDER BY t1.device_os) AS device_rank
    FROM "microsoft_ads"."keyword_performance_daily_report" AS t1
    JOIN "microsoft_ads"."account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t1.account_id
)
SELECT date, device_os, currency_code, account_name, date_rank FROM ranked WHERE date_rank <= 10

query: Retrieve the campaign name, ad account name, date, and the aggregate information including the total number of Android installs and the average view time per campaign from the Snapchat Ads database. Ensure that only synchronized data is included and group the results by campaign name, ad account name, date, Android installs, and average view time.
sql: WITH clean_data AS (SELECT t1.name AS campaign_name, t3.name AS ad_account_name, t4.date, COALESCE(t4.android_installs, 0) AS android_installs_coalesced, COALESCE(t4.avg_view_time_millis, 0) AS avg_view_time_coalesced FROM "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.campaign_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_squad_id = t2.id WHERE t1._fivetran_synced IS NOT NULL AND t3._fivetran_synced IS NOT NULL AND t4._fivetran_synced IS NOT NULL) SELECT campaign_name, ad_account_name, date, android_installs_coalesced, avg_view_time_coalesced, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(android_installs_coalesced) AS total_android_installs, AVG(avg_view_time_coalesced) AS avg_view_time FROM clean_data GROUP BY campaign_name, ad_account_name, date, android_installs_coalesced, avg_view_time_coalesced

query: Retrieve the count and total length of URLs for each ad squad and ad account from the Snapchat Ads database, only considering ads with non-null URLs and UTM campaign codes, and order the results by total URL length in descending order.
sql: WITH raw_data AS (SELECT t2.creative_name, t2.url, t2.utm_campaign, t3.name AS ad_squad_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id WHERE t2.url IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT creative_name, url, utm_campaign, ad_squad_name, ad_account_name FROM raw_data WHERE utm_campaign IS NOT NULL), aggregated AS (SELECT ad_account_name, ad_squad_name, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(LENGTH(url)) as total_url_length FROM filtered GROUP BY ad_account_name, ad_squad_name) SELECT ad_account_name, ad_squad_name, count, total_url_length FROM aggregated ORDER BY total_url_length DESC

query: Retrieve the total impressions, total view time in milliseconds, and average saves for each ad account name and country from the Snapchat Ads database, grouping the data by ad account name and country, and also provide the count of records for each group.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS ad_account_name, t3.country, SUM(t3.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t3.attachment_total_view_time_millis) AS total_view_time, AVG(t3.saves) AS average_saves, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_geo_country_daily_report" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.id GROUP BY t2.name, t3.country

query: Retrieve the names of ad squads, campaigns, and ad accounts along with the count of records for each combination from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by ad squad, campaign, and ad account names.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS ad_squad_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, t6.name AS ad_account_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.ad_account_id GROUP BY t2.name, t3.name, t6.name

query: Retrieve the ad account ID, campaign name, ad account name, and creative name, along with the total spend, average number of impressions, and count of records from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by ad account ID, campaign name, ad account name, and creative name.
sql: SELECT t2.ad_account_id, t6.name AS campaign_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name, t2.creative_name, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, AVG(t4.impressions) AS average_impressions, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.campaign_id GROUP BY t2.ad_account_id, t6.name, t5.name, t2.creative_name

query: Retrieve the creative names, URLs, and ad squad names along with the total impressions, total spend, and total purchases for each creative from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql: SELECT t2.creative_name, t2.url, t3.name AS ad_squad_name, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, SUM(t4.conversion_purchases) AS total_purchases FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id  GROUP BY t2.creative_name, t2.url, t3.name

query: Retrieve the count of records for each combination of ad name, ad squad name, and campaign name from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by ad name, ad squad name, and campaign name.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_name, t2.name AS ad_squad_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.campaign_id GROUP BY t1.name, t2.name, t3.name

query: Retrieve the campaign names, ad account names, total impressions, total spend, average swipes, and average purchase value from the Snapchat Ads database, with data grouped by campaign and ad account.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS campaign_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, AVG(t4.swipes) AS average_swipes, AVG(t4.conversion_purchases_value) AS average_purchase_value FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_squad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.ad_account_id GROUP BY t3.name, t5.name

query: Retrieve the names of ads, associated account names, and campaign names along with the total count of ads created, grouped by each ad name, account name, and campaign name from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_name, t5.name AS account_name, t6.name AS campaign_name, COUNT(*) AS total_ads_created FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.campaign_id GROUP BY t1.name, t5.name, t6.name

query: Retrieve the date, ad squad name, ad account name, campaign name, total spend, and total impressions from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by date, ad squad, ad account, and campaign, and limited to the first 1000 results.
sql: SELECT t4.date, t3.name AS ad_squad_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name, t6.name AS campaign_name, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.campaign_id GROUP BY t4.date, t3.name, t5.name, t6.name LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the total impressions, total spend, and total purchase value for each ad, along with the associated account name, from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by ad ID and account name.
sql: SELECT t4.ad_id, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, t5.name AS account_name, SUM(t4.conversion_purchases_value) AS total_purchase_value FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id GROUP BY t4.ad_id, t5.name

query: Retrieve the creative names and their count, along with the names of the associated ad squads, ad accounts, and campaigns from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by creative name, ad squad name, ad account name, and campaign name.
sql: SELECT t2.creative_name, COUNT(t2.creative_id) AS creative_count, t3.name AS ad_squad_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name, t6.name AS campaign_name FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.campaign_id GROUP BY t2.creative_name, t3.name, t5.name, t6.name

query: Retrieve the count of ads for each ad squad, along with their corresponding campaign and account names, from the Snapchat Ads database. The data is grouped by ad squad name, campaign name, and account name.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS ad_squad_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, t4.name AS account_name, COUNT(*) AS ad_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t3.ad_account_id GROUP BY t2.name, t3.name, t4.name

query: Retrieve the count of records for each ad squad name along with their corresponding ad account names from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS ad_squad_name, t6.name AS ad_account_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.ad_account_id GROUP BY t2.name, t6.name

query: Retrieve the total impressions and total spend for each date, ad account name, and campaign name from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql: SELECT t4.date, t5.name, t6.name AS campaign_name, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.campaign_id GROUP BY t4.date, t5.name, t6.name

query: Retrieve the total impressions and total spend for each date, ad name, and ad squad name from the Snapchat Ads database, limited to the first 1000 results.
sql: SELECT t1.date, t2.name AS ad_name, t3.name AS ad_squad_name, SUM(t1.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t1.spend) AS total_spend FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.ad_squad_id GROUP BY t1.date, t2.name, t3.name LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the name of each ad squad and ad account from the Snapchat Ads database, along with the total number of associated campaigns and the average synchronization time, grouped by ad squad and ad account name.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS ad_squad_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name, COUNT(*) AS total_campaigns, AVG(t3._fivetran_synced) AS avg_sync_time FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id GROUP BY t3.name, t5.name

query: Retrieve the advertisement names, account names, dates, total impressions, total spend, and total purchases from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by each advertisement name, account name, and date.
sql: SELECT t2.name, t5.name AS account_name, t4.date, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, SUM(t4.conversion_purchases) AS total_purchases FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_squad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t2.id GROUP BY t2.name, t5.name, t4.date

query: Retrieve the count of records for each combination of ad name, campaign name, and account name from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t2.name AS ad_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, t5.name AS account_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t1
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_squad_id = t1.id
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t3.ad_account_id
GROUP BY t2.name, t3.name, t5.name

query: Retrieve the names of ad squads, ad accounts, and campaigns from the Snapchat Ads database, along with the total number of ad squads, only including those entries that have been synchronized. Group the results by ad squad name, ad account name, and campaign name.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS ad_squad_name, t5.name AS ad_account_name, t6.name AS campaign_name, COUNT(t3.id) AS total_ad_squads FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t6 ON t6.id = t3.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id WHERE t3._fivetran_synced IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t3.name, t5.name, t6.name

query: Retrieve the names of ad squads, their campaign IDs, account names, and synchronization details from the Snapchat Ads database, ordered by the most recently synchronized ad squads, limited to the top 1000 records.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS ad_squad_name, t3.campaign_id, t5.name AS account_name, t5._fivetran_synced, t3._fivetran_synced FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id ORDER BY t3._fivetran_synced DESC LIMIT 1000

query: Retrieve the list of campaign and ad squad details from the Snapchat Ads database, including the campaign ID, campaign name, ad squad ID, ad squad name, and the count of records for each combination of campaign and ad squad.
sql:
SELECT t1.id AS campaign_id, t1.name AS campaign_name, t2.id AS ad_squad_id, t2.name AS ad_squad_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.campaign_id = t1.id
GROUP BY t1.id, t1.name, t2.id, t2.name

query: Retrieve the names of ads, creative names, and account names along with the total impressions, total spend, and count of records for each ad from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by ad name, creative name, and account name.
sql:
SELECT t1.name AS ad_name, t2.creative_name, t5.name AS account_name, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.spend) AS total_spend, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep" AS t2 ON t2.creative_id = t1.creative_id
JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t5 ON t5.id = t2.ad_account_id
GROUP BY t1.name, t2.creative_name, t5.name

query: Retrieve the names of ad squads, ads, and campaigns along with their associated ad account IDs from the Snapchat Ads database, and find the count of creative IDs grouped by each ad squad, ad, and campaign.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_squad_name, t2.name AS ad_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, t3.ad_account_id, COUNT(*) AS avg_creative_id FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t2 ON t2.ad_squad_id = t1.id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.campaign_id GROUP BY t1.name, t2.name, t3.name, t3.ad_account_id

query: Retrieve the number of ad squads associated with each campaign and account from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by campaign name and account name.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS campaign_name, t3.name AS account_name, COUNT(*) AS ad_squad_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.ad_account_id GROUP BY t2.name, t3.name

query: Retrieve the total number of impressions for each campaign, along with the campaign ID, campaign name, ad account name, and country name from the Snapchat Ads database, grouped by campaign and country.
sql: SELECT t1.id AS campaign_id, COUNT(t3.impressions) AS total_impressions, t1.name AS campaign_name, t2.name AS ad_account_name, t3.country AS country_name FROM "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_account_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_geo_country_daily_report" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.id  GROUP BY t1.id, t1.name, t2.name, t3.country

query: Retrieve the names of campaigns and their corresponding account names from the Snapchat Ads database, along with the count of ads associated with each, for those campaigns that have more than one ad.
sql: SELECT t3.name AS campaign_name, t4.name AS account_name, COUNT(*) AS ad_count FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t4 ON t4.id = t3.ad_account_id GROUP BY t3.name, t4.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

query: Retrieve the names of ads, ad squads, and campaigns along with the total impressions for each, grouped by ad name, ad squad name, and campaign name from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql: SELECT t1.name AS ad_name, t2.name AS ad_squad_name, t3.name AS campaign_name, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions FROM "snapchat_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_squad_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_squad_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.campaign_id JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_hourly_report" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.id GROUP BY t1.name, t2.name, t3.name

query: Retrieve the latest five records of campaign names, account names, and their corresponding impressions from the Snapchat Ads database.
sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT t1.name AS campaign_name, t2.name AS account_name, t3.impressions,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.id ORDER BY t3.date DESC) AS row_num
    FROM "snapchat_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1
    JOIN "snapchat_ads"."ad_account_history" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.ad_account_id
    JOIN "snapchat_ads"."campaign_hourly_report" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.id
)
SELECT campaign_name, account_name, impressions FROM cte WHERE row_num <= 5

query: Retrieve the campaign ID, total active budget, advertiser name, country, and campaign name from the Tiktok Ads database, grouped by each campaign ID, advertiser name, country, and campaign name, focusing only on active campaigns.
sql: SELECT t3.campaign_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.operation_status = 'active' THEN t3.budget ELSE 0 END) AS active_budget, t2.name, t2.country, t3.campaign_name FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."advertiser" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.advertiser_id GROUP BY t3.campaign_id, t2.name, t2.country, t3.campaign_name

query: Retrieve the advertiser names, campaign names, types, placement categories, total impressions, and average cost per click from the Tiktok Ads database, grouped by advertiser and campaign details, while categorizing placements as 'In-App' or 'Other' based on their type.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS advertiser_name, t3.campaign_name, t3.campaign_type, CASE WHEN t5.placement_type = 'in_app' THEN 'In-App' ELSE 'Other' END AS placement_category, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, AVG(t4.cpc) AS average_cpc FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."ad_report_hourly" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.ad_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."adgroup_history" AS t5 ON t5.adgroup_id = t1.ad_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."advertiser" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.advertiser_id GROUP BY t2.name, t3.campaign_name, t3.campaign_type, placement_category

query: Retrieve the average budget along with the campaign name, campaign type, budget mode, placement type, and app type from the Tiktok Ads database, grouped by these attributes.
sql: SELECT t3.campaign_name, t3.campaign_type, t3.budget_mode, t5.placement_type, t5.app_type, AVG(t3.budget) AS avg_budget FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."adgroup_history" AS t5 ON t5.adgroup_id = t1.ad_id GROUP BY t3.campaign_name, t3.campaign_type, t3.budget_mode, t5.placement_type, t5.app_type

query: Retrieve the total impressions for each advertisement along with the advertiser's name and the report hour from the Tiktok Ads database.
sql: SELECT t4.ad_id, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, t2.name AS advertiser_name, t4.stat_time_hour AS report_hour FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."ad_report_hourly" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.ad_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."advertiser" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.advertiser_id GROUP BY t4.ad_id, t2.name, t4.stat_time_hour

query: Retrieve the average cost per conversion, total video views, and total impressions for each advertiser, along with their name, industry, country, and currency from the Tiktok Ads database, grouped by advertiser details.
sql:
SELECT t4.name, t4.industry, t4.country, t4.currency,
  AVG(t3.cost_per_conversion) AS avg_cost_per_conversion,
  SUM(t3.video_views_p_75) AS total_video_views,
  SUM(t3.impressions) AS total_impressions
FROM "tiktok_ads"."adgroup_history" AS t1
JOIN "tiktok_ads"."adgroup_report_hourly" AS t3 ON t3.adgroup_id = t1.adgroup_id
JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS tc ON tc.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id
JOIN "tiktok_ads"."advertiser" AS t4 ON t4.id = tc.advertiser_id
GROUP BY t4.name, t4.industry, t4.country, t4.currency

query: Retrieve the names and industries of advertisers from the Tiktok Ads database, along with the hourly statistics showing the average cost per conversion and the total number of video views at 75% completion, grouped by advertiser name, industry, and hour.
sql: SELECT t2.name, t2.industry, t3.stat_time_hour, AVG(t3.cost_per_conversion) AS avg_cost_per_conversion, SUM(t3.video_views_p_75) AS total_video_views_p_75 FROM "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_report_hourly" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."advertiser" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.advertiser_id GROUP BY t2.name, t2.industry, t3.stat_time_hour;

query: Retrieve the top 50 TikTok advertising campaigns ranked by total impressions, showing the campaign name, the count of unique ads, the total number of impressions, the total results, and the average budget for each campaign.
sql: SELECT t3.campaign_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ad_id) AS unique_ads, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.real_time_result) AS total_results, AVG(t3.budget) AS avg_budget FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."ad_report_hourly" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.ad_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."adgroup_history" AS t5 ON t5.adgroup_id = t1.ad_id GROUP BY t3.campaign_name ORDER BY total_impressions DESC LIMIT 50

query: Retrieve the advertiser names, advertisement names, and ad group names along with the total number of ads and the date of the last update from the Tiktok Ads database, grouped by advertiser name, advertisement name, ad group name, and update date.
sql: SELECT t2.name AS advertiser_name, t1.ad_name AS advertisement_name, t5.adgroup_name AS ad_group_name, SUM(CAST(t1.ad_id AS INTEGER)) AS total_ads, t1.updated_at FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."adgroup_history" AS t5 ON t5.adgroup_id = t1.ad_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."advertiser" AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.advertiser_id GROUP BY t2.name, t1.ad_name, t5.adgroup_name, t1.updated_at

query: Retrieve the ad names, advertiser IDs, impressions, cost per click (CPC), and clicks from the Tiktok Ads database.
sql:
SELECT t1.ad_name, t1.advertiser_id, t3.impressions, t3.cpc, t3.clicks
FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1
JOIN "tiktok_ads"."ad_report_hourly" AS t3 ON t3.ad_id = t1.ad_id

query: Retrieve the average cost per click, total impressions, and total video views for each ad, grouped by ad name, campaign name, and budget mode from the Tiktok Ads database.
sql: SELECT t1.ad_name, t3.campaign_name, t3.budget_mode, AVG(t4.cpc) AS avg_cpc, SUM(t4.impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(t4.video_views_p_100) AS total_video_views FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id JOIN "tiktok_ads"."ad_report_hourly" AS t4 ON t4.ad_id = t1.ad_id GROUP BY t1.ad_name, t3.campaign_name, t3.budget_mode

query: Retrieve the total budget for each campaign of every advertiser, along with the campaign name and budget mode from the Tiktok Ads database, grouped by advertiser and campaign.
sql: SELECT t1.advertiser_id, t1.campaign_id, t3.campaign_name, t3.budget_mode, SUM(t3.budget) AS total_budget FROM "tiktok_ads"."ad_history" AS t1 JOIN "tiktok_ads"."campaign_history" AS t3 ON t3.campaign_id = t1.campaign_id GROUP BY t1.advertiser_id, t1.campaign_id, t3.campaign_name, t3.budget_mode
